module_boundary_evidence.module: Hosted-history current aliases, typed edits and inverse projection
module_boundary_evidence.owner: Chat Process registered field editor owns current edits; registered current-history projection owns inverse emission
module_boundary_evidence.paths: docs/design/v3-req02-hosted-history-operator-contract-20261005.md; docs/design/v3-req02-current-field-associations.md; docs/architecture/v3-resource-operation-map.yml; docs/architecture/manifests/v3.operation_runner.lifecycle.manifest.yml. Allowed implementation is existing field-editor/library/current-history helpers; REQ06 project_canonical_request.rs, Server, Compat and response governance remain outside this slice.
module_boundary_evidence.edges: Original event action maps to encoded assistant arguments and event-JSON action aliases; one public typed edit updates surviving aliases atomically; ordered conflicting edits use the later explicit edit. Structural edits move/remove associations with actual elements. Current inverse associates contributions by original source item rather than array position or name search and emits one hosted item. Full deletion emits none; partial deletion uses surviving current contributions without recreating removed business values. No callback or cross-node state mutation is added.
module_boundary_evidence.resources: Immutable request_inverse_context and explicit_history_pairing retain original associations; request-local current_field_associations stores original mapping references and current structural paths only. Current canonical values own edited action/result data. Opaque source references recover shape/presence/encoding, not stale business values. GovernChatRequest remains the sole current-association writer; projection consumes a local view.
module_boundary_evidence.gates: Contract requires public normalize/edit/current-inverse consumers covering unchanged equality, call-only and event-only action edits, conflicting edits in both orders, nonoverlapping event/result changes, complete and partial deletion, unknown nested fields, absent/nonobject arguments, long strings and CRLF. Acceptance asserts alias consistency and no resurrection. Helper/map/gate and supported alias-encoding bindings must be registered before coding. Full candidate tool-execution and follow-up gates remain separate; historical hosted representation does not claim that a current client tool ran.

module_boundary_evidence.module: Operation-runner graph, attempt isolation and finalization
module_boundary_evidence.owner: RuntimeRequestGraphEntry and non-Clone Runtime finalizer; Error chain owns internal failures; Server forwards opaque request handles
module_boundary_evidence.edges: Hosted operator reuses capture → normalize → target/execution planning → current governance → standard/registered Direct projection → transport. Successful attempt admission precedes successful-context publication and inverse/client framing. Failed attempts terminate through typed Error/Runtime disposition; retry starts another attempt without replacing the immutable original pair. Cancellation, disconnect, future/stream Drop and terminal completion release attempt scope before request scope. Hosted operator adds no process, listener, lifecycle owner or graph backedge.
module_boundary_evidence.resources: Original inverse/history pair and current associations are request-scoped; projection/declaration context is attempt-scoped. Failed attempt state cannot enter the successful response view. Business payload and typed control resources remain separate. Compile/internal failures have internal typed exits; they do not authorize client error responses or fabricated successful terminal events.
module_boundary_evidence.gates: Read-only dagpipe graph validate succeeded for request (9 nodes/9 edges), response (5 nodes/4 edges) and error (6 nodes/5 edges); these results prove static topology only. git diff HEAD --check succeeded. SDK registry/schema/effect compilation, executable hosted operator, real HTTP/WS behavior, exact-candidate runtime delivery and implementation review remain pending and are not claimed by this design. Pure design review does not require runtime lifecycle actions or development/debug stage-note writes.

findings.rule: Clarify identity selection for present fields without a usable nonempty identity
findings.evidence: identity_paths requires a nonempty call identity, but generated_identity_prefix is described as applying only when every configured field is absent. Present empty-string, null or nonstring identity fields therefore have no explicit selection rule. The referenced established helper, responses_openai_codec.rs::build_v3_openai_chat_hosted_tool_history_call_id, selects the first nonempty string and generates a source-index identity whenever none is usable, including when fields are present. This is a design ambiguity; no current implementation regression is established in this documentation-only tree.
findings.remediation: Describe generation as applying when no configured path supplies a usable nonempty string, while preserving original field values and presence in the event/inverse. Add present-empty/null/nonstring ID cases to the planned public roundtrip coverage.
